text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober carves her name into<n>history after
completing the Triple<n>Tiara with an outstanding
performance!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though the audience's cheers<n>threaten to move
her to tears, Mejiro<n>Dober presents herself in a
refined<n>manner befitting a queen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober thanks me<n>again for
believing in her, and the two<n>of us take our first
step toward our<n>new future!
